_readme: Stations × providers × models. The only place a provider or model slug may appear; .py files never name one. A rate is a READING with a date and a source — where sources disagree both readings stay, and the ledger takes the reading that matches the tier/resolution it is asked for: an exact-resolution reading beats a later null-resolution one, and among equals the latest read wins. A null resolution on a reading means the source did not state one, so it matches any.
_registry: Slugs are each provider's own (Higgsfield job_set_type, fal endpoint ids). Pending fold-in to components/models/ as aliases — the developer's gate, not done here.

_house.ruling: the owner: we have many providers and many models — streamline the models used so any tool, fal or Higgsfield, can do what's necessary. Approved families only: Google (Omni, Nano Banana) · ByteDance (Seedance, Seedream) · GPT Image · ElevenLabs. MiniMax and Kling retired. Role map: Seedream = stills/identity chaining · Nano Banana = editing/compositing real artifacts · GPT Image = photo-ref exact recreate · Seedance (+ Omni) = clips · ElevenLabs = voice.
_house.rule: one primary model per station per provider; a fallback only for a measured misfire (or a named, narrow use the primary cannot do); retired and superseded models are never deleted — their ceilings are knowledge, kept with a status of retired or alternate.
_house.ruling_2026_10_03: the owner, 2026-10-03, after the Nova Section 1 test (Omni 360p, Omni 720p, Seedance 480p + blurred swipe, MiniMax 2K, same picture, voice and fixed prompt, checked frame by frame): "damn omni crushed it that looks really good". Talking to camera = Google Omni (fal, controlled-Omni recipe: the line in the prompt, Nova's voice swapped in by ElevenLabs speech-to-speech) at 360p (~$__/s), upscaled locally afterwards (the owner 2026-10-02: "we can always upscale content locally anyway"). Seedance 2.5 stays the door for clips that copy the swipe's movement (blurred footage), since Omni takes no video reference.
_house.ruling_2026_10_03_provider: the owner, 2026-10-03, after the same two Nova tests through every provider that sells Omni (fal $__ / 33-47 s, Google direct $__ / 22-38 s, Higgsfield ~$__ / 45 s-3 min; identical inputs; machine/omni_bench.py, runs/video-production/<brand>/<run>): "go with fal for sure". Omni runs on fal ($__/s at 360p): image-to-video for talking, reference-to-video (picture + up to 3 x 3 s of BLURRED swipe) for movement.
_house.ruling_2026_10_03_voice: the owner, 2026-10-03, after hearing Section 1 two ways (A: the clip model speaks the line, ElevenLabs speech-to-speech turns it into the cast voice; B: the approved take time-aligned to the lips), both with the crisp finish: "version a actually sounds like the avatar looks". On-camera lines = A + the crisp finish (machine/omni.py CRISP). Also: "even the doctor's voice sounded better with omni".
_house.ruling_2026_10_03_voice_first_retired: the owner, 2026-10-03, on the voice-first workflow it replaces: the audio was made first only to cut dead air before the scenes were made; "it's actually just easier to generate the voices directly from the model itself, and then we can adjust the voice later. Also, the lip sync's already done … it's just literally just changing the voice." Dead air: clips made to storyboard length, trimmed to first/last spoken word by the clip's own word timings.
_house.ruling_2026_10_03_face_lock: the owner, 2026-10-03, on the Nova clips: "you're literally changing this woman's eye color and face … troubleshoot the problem at a fundamental level so that we can not have this happen again". Fix in the chain: clips made at 1080p (no upscale), each person's eyes/marks from their casting spec written into every prompt, a person on screen locks the approved picture as the first frame (no reference mode), and a face lock check (eye colour vs the approved picture, face model when it answers) remakes a drifting clip once.
_house.ruling_2026_10_03_sounds: the owner, 2026-10-03, on the Nova clips: sounds that are not words ("umms", "hmm", "uh-huh", "mm-hmm") do not come out clean when Omni mouths them. "We should just keep that as a separate sound, not worry about lip sync there. Obviously, keep her head nod, but we don't need to put in the vocals with it." In the chain: a line that is only a sound is never said on camera; the person on screen nods, lips closed; the sound is made in the cloned voice and laid in at the edit. A sound at the start or end of a spoken line is cut from what Omni says and made the same way.
_house.ruling_2026_10_03_no_handoffs: the owner, 2026-10-03: "there's a fundamental level that needs to be addressed … check for root cause, isolate it and change that". Root cause of the Nova face drift: clips started from the previous clip's last frame (a copy of a copy). 17 clips from the approved picture held; all 10 handed-on clips drifted, worse each hand-off. In the chain: a person on screen means every clip starts from the approved picture; no hand-offs.
_house.ruling_2026_10_03_no_invented_speech: 3 Oct (Nova edit): the clip prompt said "Someone off camera talks now" and Omni invented the off-camera lines ("Apply this gentle scrub…", "We'll trace the laser…") in 4 clips; the words check only confirmed the scripted line was there. Off-camera stretches now say nobody speaks; the real line is its own track. The edit keeps a clip's sound only across its scripted words.
_house.ruling_2026_09_17: the owner, 2026-09-17, verbatim intent: GPT Image for ALL initial image generation from reference and for building the cast; discrete edits with nano_banana_pro; motion (the animation of an approved still) with seedance 2.5; talking/lip-sync ALSO on seedance — "we nailed it directly through Higgsfield and didn't use Cinema Studio at all"; voice = ElevenLabs; audio = the non-voice sound (the song for sung formats, music/effects otherwise — the editor's).
flags_2026_09_17: SUPERSEDES THE-CINEMA-LINE.md's 2026-09-12 ruling on the talking beat only ('never marry audio to video' → cinematic_studio_3_0 as the whole architecture). The 16 Sep run proved seedance_2_5 with the approved still as start_image and the ElevenLabs line attached as a media with role audio — the locked-voice rule held. Cinema Studio is now the talking FALLBACK if sync drifts, not the primary route. Everything else in THE-CINEMA-LINE.md (element injection, the receipts) still stands.

The audio station (seed_audio / ace-step) makes the SONG, and only for sung formats. There is no house call for anything else in that slot — music beds and sound effects are the editor's, per the owner 2026-09-17.
_house.principle_layer: The reference-level doctrine behind every pick in this file is `GENERATION-METHOD.md` (the reference carries the material; generate what must be photographic, composite what must be exact; never name the camera; judge by measurement, not taste). The course write-up (the owner, 09-14) corroborates the ruling and confirms the same model split: realism of a person → GPT Image; edits → Nano Banana Pro.
_house.ruling_2026_09_17_voice: the owner: voice is the direct ElevenLabs account, one custom voice per character — the line is generated first, from here, via the direct API, and the audio is piped into the provider (uploaded to Higgsfield as the media the talking beat lip-syncs to; on fal attached as the audio input); fal's own ElevenLabs endpoints see library voices only and cannot reach an account-private voice id (no key passthrough, no clone/design endpoint on fal — research confirmed).
_house.ruling_2026_09_17_song: the owner: song is Lyria 3 Pro on fal (fal-ai/lyria3/pro, $__/song, up to 3 min, sings written lyrics) so model usage stays on fal/Higgsfield; fal returns no lyric timings, so the timing sheet comes from one more fal call, fal-ai/elevenlabs/speech-to-text, on the finished song; Lyria via the Gemini API direct is the alternate (it returns timings natively); fal-ai/minimax-music/v2.6 is the alternate that sings lyrics with structure tags; fal-ai/ace-step is retired (lost the test).
_house.ruling_2026_09_18: ONE HAND. Every station is a direct call from run.py start — voice (ElevenLabs), cast/still (OpenAI), edit (Google), song (Google Lyria), talking AND silent motion (fal Omni via machine/omni.py). Nothing in the chain needs the Higgsfield MCP (the owner 15:20). Higgsfield and fal-as-a-house remain FORCED alternates only (--provider); BytePlus direct is wired and blocked on US billing; the Higgsfield API was declined. The editor sheet (SUBMIT.md) is written only when a house is forced.
_house.amended: 2026-09-22 (the owner, twice in one day). First, after the bake-off, MiniMax H3 through Higgsfield took motion AND talking. Then, after four prompt-tuning takes on MiniMax against one Seedance take of the same scene, he reversed it: "let's just run with seedance for now, the output is just way better and takes less tweaking" — and again the same evening, "we should've went back to seedance and no minimax for video". SEEDANCE 2.5 IS THE CLIP DOOR for motion and talking; MiniMax H3 is not a door at all, and models.minimax_h3 is kept only as the record of what it could and could not do (it needed the prompt rebuilt four ways and still would not land on the last frame). GPT Image 2.5 stays every still, ElevenLabs the voice. Shape and numbers: doors.motion / doors.talking.
_house.ruling_2026_09_23_song: the owner, 2026-09-23, after a blind two-round test (generic beds, then late-90s neo-soul R&B), ElevenLabs Music vs Google Lyria 3, same prompts, levelled and shuffled: "Eleven Labs won for me for sure." The SONG door is ElevenLabs Music, newest model music_v2_5, called direct by machine/song.py from the brief's song block only (SONG-CHAIN.md). Lyria (direct:google, lyria-3-pro-preview) is kept as the alternate: a legacy prompt-shaped song block still goes there. Supersedes ruling_2026_09_17_song and the song half of ruling_2026_09_18.

protected_words.why: every brand, product, ingredient and mechanism word in a line (brands/<brand>/brand-identity/voice/pronunciation.json) must be heard in the transcript, matched on its REAL spelling — fuzzy, because the transcriber writes a brand word its own way. A miss is one voice-only remake, then a stop naming the word. the owner, 2026-09-23: "make sure brand names, ingredients, mechanisms are never mispronounced". Calibrated on the say-it proof, 2026-09-23 (runs/video-production/<brand>/<run>): words said right were heard at 0.857 ('Brand A' written 'Veluna'), 0.895 ('Brand A's product') and 1.0; words said wrong at 0.3-0.70, and one wrong respelling at 0.80 ('Sentella' for centella) - so 0.85 sits between them. words.keep: The image is the first frame: keep it exactly as it is, the same framing and distance from the lens, the same people, faces, clothes, place, signs and light. Nothing is re-staged, re-framed or zoomed.
words.identity_hold: No one's eye colour, face shape, skin marks or hair ever changes.
words.identity_even: This is after the routine: {poss} face is even now, with no dark spots or age-spot patches anywhere on it, exactly as even as in the first frame.
words.keep_end: It ends exactly on the second picture: the same people, place and light, in the positions that picture shows.
words.refs: The {videos} {are} blurred {clips} of the original footage, used ONLY for movement: copy how the camera moves and how every person and hand moves, where each touch lands, and the timing of each movement. Take nothing else from {them}: no person, face, hair, clothes, sign, words, captions or place.
words.camera_ref_prefix: The camera moves only as it does in the blurred {videos}.
words.camera_selfie: A real phone selfie held at {her} own arm's length: the frame is never quite still, it drifts and bobs gently with {her} arm and {her} breathing, the way handheld front-camera video does.
words.camera_mirror: A real mirror selfie, the phone in {her} hand: the frame drifts gently with {her} arm and breathing, the way a handheld phone does.
words.camera_held: The phone is held by someone standing close: a slight, natural handheld drift.
words.camera_still: The phone is set down and still: the frame does not move.
words.speak: {who} says{tone}, {pos} lips moving with every word: "{line}"
words.off: {visible} {listen} in silence and {react} with the face only, lips closed. Nobody speaks in this moment: no voice at all.
words.off_none: Nobody speaks in this moment: no voice at all.
words.hold: After the last word, everyone holds still, no laughing, nothing else is said.
words.silent: Nobody in the picture speaks; lips stay closed.
words.alive: Everything in the picture moves gently and naturally: {subject}
words.nod: {who} nods slightly, lips closed, without making a sound.
words.finish: One continuous take from the first frame to the last: no cuts, no jumps, no change of set-up; anything held stays in the same hand. Never write any words on the picture: no subtitles, no captions, no speech text, no titles. No music.

the menu: run.py models — every pickable model with what it is good at, what it is weak at, and its price
picking.rule: a pick nothing answers to is refused BY NAME with the menu, never a silent fall back to the settled door — that is how a run quietly costs 3x what it was asked to

roster.why: the owner, 2026-09-22: the roster is two. SEEDANCE is the default — it carries physical cause and effect on the first take and needs no prompt tuning; MINIMAX is the pick for a scene with no physical action in it, at 2 cr/s and 2K against Seedance 12 cr/s at 1080p.

open_decision.superseded: 2026-10-03 — the clips moved to Omni on fal (_house ruling_2026_10_03, direct.omni_route); this Seedance/MiniMax split is the legacy doors' record only.
open_decision.question: which model owns which kind of scene — the per-usage split
open_decision.ruled_for_now: the owner, 2026-09-22: "this is fine for now, we need to run through a few more briefs before I can confidently switch models for different video gen usages." EVERY scene goes to seedance_2_5 until he rules otherwise. Nobody splits it on one scene's evidence.
what_would_settle_it: talking scenes across several briefs on both doors: minimax_h3 measured 100% line parity and good lip sync at a sixth of the price, on ONE scene
B-roll / hands scenes across several briefs: seedance carried the physical cause and effect on the first take where minimax needed four prompt rewrites, on ONE scene
whether a talking scene actually needs its last frame attached (seedance can, minimax cannot) once several briefs' scene-to-scene continuity is looked at end to end
open_decision.how_the_evidence_accumulates: every run.json records clip_model, clip_model_by and scene_models, so the briefs themselves are the record — no list to keep.
